recommendation: Keep the audit commit for FHIR-core reconciliation. If the rendering problem still reproduces in current publisher releases, track the fix in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher or the current publisher/template tooling repository.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Jira requested that the IG Publisher render all profiles when an ElementDefinition type has multiple profiles of the same resource type instead of showing only one profile link.
initial_application: No prior FHIR-core source application was found: the current checkout has no source mention of FHIR-22939 or the PAS profile example, no Java publisher implementation, and the combined branch had no existing Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for this issue.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini includes ElementDefinition definitions and profiles, but the reported defect concerns IG Publisher runtime rendering rather than specification semantics. Indexed Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no contrary work-group evidence. GitHub searches found related HL7/fhir-ig-publisher rendering/template issues, reinforcing that comparable fixes are tracked outside this repository.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no source changes, because the current HL7/fhir checkout does not contain the active IG Publisher rendering code needed to implement the requested behavior.

evidence_items.learned: The assignee's comment classifies the request as a tooling issue, so no FHIR-core source semantics are required.
